reason: B is the better proposal because it makes a novel, testable extension of coherent-nanoprecipitate strengthening to single-step LPBF, whereas A essentially repeats the intervention, alloy, mechanism, and achieved properties already reported in E1–E3. B remains high-risk because ultrafast solidification may retain a supersaturated matrix rather than directly form coherent precipitates, but its phase/defect characterization and mechanical comparison can decisively test that mechanism.
